verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say users can attach documents to chat messages and interact with them entirely offline as RAG. The 0.3.0 release notes describe built-in document Q&A that works with any local model, and a community user mentions RAG plugins. The 'automatic' part of the story is only implied: nothing documents how retrieval is triggered or managed without user intervention, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documentation of automatic retrieval behavior (when it triggers, chunking and embedding handled without user setup), details on supported document types and scale, independent hands-on corroboration of offline document chat quality

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can chat with my own documents entirely offline using automatic retrieval-augmented generation

citations.quote: You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline, also known as "RAG".
LM Studio 0.3.0 comes with built-in functionality to provide a set of document to an LLM and ask questions about them.
LM Studio 0.3.0 supports this with any local model that can run in LM Studio!
